title: Step-Saver, Arizona Retail, Orris, and Mortenson
shortTitle: Step-Saver, Arizona Retail, Orris, and Mortenson
summary: Klocek surveys decisions using earlier formation, proposed modification, or rolling formation.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The survey distinguishes shipping-and-payment conduct, an alleged already completed sale, and a prior course of dealing involving license terms. Those different routes explain why treating every in-box license as the same event would misstate the cases. No full opinions have been invented from the short parentheticals.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 299–302. Open assigned page 299.
